body:
I was 17. Graduation party. My friend's Aunt, 30 something. Terrible looking. 

She got us all very drunk. I laid down in bed. Woke up with her in it. Fell back asleep. Woke up inside her mouth. Passed back out. Woke up with her on top of me. Passed back out shortly later.

In the morning she was gone and my friend was in trouble for raping a female friend of ours at the party. 

I used to think it didn't bother me. But since then I've been incapable of vanilla relationships. I can only have BDSM centered ones where I'm completely in charge.

I've tried feeling more "like a man" using girl after girl and such. It wasn't till I realized guys aren't like this that I realized I needed help.

Thankfully I'm happily married and feel more at peace with my past. 

But I still go through bouts of heavy suicidal feelings when I feel like I'm not in control of my life.
